title: Asiastar C9 Gas Buses Delivered to Uzbekistan Market
summary: A batch of Asiastar C9 gas-powered buses was delivered to Uzbekistan, the first time this series styling enters the market, offering a tailored Chinese solution for local urban public transport upgrades.
content:
Starting from Chang'an, traversing Central Asia, and reaching Rome, the camel bells of the ancient Silk Road once linked the millennium-long friendship between China and Central Asia. Today, empowered by the "Belt and Road" Initiative, this connection across the Tianshan Mountains has been endowed with a brand-new connotation of the era.

## Ancient Silk Road Gets a New Look! Batch Delivery of Asiastar C9 Gas-Powered Buses to Uzbekistan

On March 25, 2026, it was learned that a batch of Asiastar C9 gas-powered buses was officially delivered to Uzbekistan. This is not only a landing of "Intelligent Manufacturing in China" overseas but also the first time this series' styling has entered the Uzbekistan market, bringing a tailored Chinese solution for the upgrade of local urban public transportation.

### Precise Adaptation: Green Power, Anchoring Local Low-Carbon Travel Needs

Uzbekistan is rich in natural gas resources, and its local public transportation system has long taken clean energy vehicles as its core development direction, while maintaining strict Euro V emission standards for vehicles.

Based on the local energy structure and operational needs, the C9 gas buses delivered this time are equipped with the Weichai WP7NG210E51 Euro V natural gas engine. With a rated power of 155kW and a peak torque of 850N·m, the power reserve can both meet the smooth start and continuous cruising on urban roads and perfectly adapt to the local energy supply system, significantly reducing the fuel costs for bus operators while achieving low-carbon and environmental protection emissions.

Uzbekistan has a typical temperate continental climate, where extreme high temperatures in summer exceed 50°C and winters are severely cold, placing extremely high requirements on the environmental adaptability and operational reliability of vehicles. Aiming at local full-scenario operational pain points, the C9 gas bus has undergone comprehensive customized upgrades:

**Coping with Extreme High Temperatures:** Equipped with a high-power air conditioning unit, it can achieve rapid full-area cooling even under the severe working conditions of extreme outdoor high temperatures and a full load of passengers, completely bidding farewell to the "steamer feel" of summer buses and creating a refreshing travel environment for citizens throughout the journey.

**Full-Area Heating in Severe Cold Weather:** Equipped with an independent fuel heater and paired with multidirectional radiators and a dedicated radiator for the driver, it achieves zoned constant-temperature heating for the entire vehicle. In subzero environments, passengers enjoy warmth as soon as they board.

**Exclusive Protection for Complex Road Conditions:** A dedicated protective baffle is installed at the bottom of the water tank to effectively block impact damage from crushed stones to core components, greatly reducing the vehicle failure rate and fully guaranteeing the bus operation attendance rate, while reducing maintenance costs for the operator.

### Warm Travel: Making Bus Services Cover Everyone

The core value of public transportation is to serve every citizen in the city. The C9 gas buses delivered this time are positioned as responsive buses. The flexible operation mode of "stop upon waving" can flexibly adapt stop locations according to the travel needs of citizens, maximizing travel convenience. At the same time, the interior space design fully covers the travel needs of all groups: the vehicle adopts a two-step design, with 1 dedicated wheelchair area and 2 manual steps for the disabled inside the car, ensuring travel convenience for different groups.

The debut of the C9 gas bus in Uzbekistan is an important step for Asiastar Bus to deeply cultivate the Central Asian market and a vivid microcosm of the Chinese bus industry practicing the "Belt and Road" Initiative. In the future, Asiastar Bus will continue to take user needs as the core and technological innovation as the drive, heading to more global markets with travel solutions that better fit local needs, letting the strength and warmth of "Intelligent Manufacturing in China" be seen by the world.
